lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo maagahi soee soee paavahi sev har ke charan rasaain ||
lines.translation: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I serve at the Lord's feet, the source of nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran duhahoo te chhootahi bhavajal jagat taraain ||1||
lines.translation: I am released from the bondage of birth and death, and so I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat tat beechaario daas govi(n)d paraain ||
lines.translation: Searching and seeking, I have come to understand the essence of reality; the slave of the Lord of the Universe is dedicated to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖੇਮ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: abinaasee khem chaahahi je naanak sadaa simar naaraain ||2||5||10||
lines.translation: If you desire eternal bliss, O Nanak, ever remember the Lord in meditation. ||2||5||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak gur kirapaa te haatio ||
lines.translation: The slanderer, by Guru's Grace, has been turned away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਿਵ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae daiaalaa siv kai baan sir kaatio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful; with Shiva's arrow, He shot his head off. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪੰਥਾ ਥਾਟਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai sach kaa pa(n)thaa thaatio ||
lines.translation: Death, and the noose of death, cannot see me; I have adopted the Path of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhutat naahee raam ratan dhan khaatio ||1||
lines.translation: I have earned the wealth, the jewel of the Lord's Name; eating and spending, it is never used up. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਸਮਾ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhasamaa bhoot hoaa khin bheetar apanaa keeaa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: In an instant, the slanderer was reduced to ashes; he received the rewards of his own actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagam nigam kahai jan naanak sabh dekhai lok sabaaiaa ||2||6||11||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the truth of the scriptures; the whole world is witness to it. ||2||6||11||

lines.transliteration: todee mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapan tan man kilavikh bhare ||
lines.translation: O miser, your body and mind are full of sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਢਾਕਨ ਕਉ ਇਕੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhajan kar suaamee dhaakan kau ik hare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate, meditate on the Lord and Master; He alone can cover your sins. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਥਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik chhidr bohith ke chhutakat thaam na jaahee kare ||
lines.translation: When many holes appear in your boat, you cannot plug them with your hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa bohith tis aaraadhe khote sa(n)g khare ||1||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the One, to whom your boat belongs; He saves the counterfeit along with the genuine. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਸੈਲ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਚਾਹੈ ਓਇ ਊਹਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: galee sail uthaavat chaahai oi oohaa hee hai dhare ||
lines.translation: People want to lift up the mountain with mere words, but it just stays there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jor sakat naanak kichh naahee prabh raakhahu saran pare ||2||7||12||
lines.translation: Nanak has no strength or power at all; O God, please protect me - I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||7||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke charan kamal man dhiaau ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਪਿਤ ਬਾਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh kuthaar pit baat ha(n)taa aukhadh har ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine; it is like an axe, which destroys the diseases caused by anger and egotism. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਦੁਖ ਹੰਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: teene taap nivaaranahaaraa dukh ha(n)taa sukh raas ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the One who removes the three fevers; He is the Destroyer of pain, the warehouse of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau bighan na kooo laagai jaa kee prabh aagai aradaas ||1||
lines.translation: No obstacles block the path of one who prays before God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੈਦ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad baid naaraain karan kaaran prabh ek ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has become my physician; God alone is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: baal budh pooran sukhadaataa naanak har har tek ||2||8||13||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of perfect peace to the innocent-minded people; O Nanak, the Lord, Har, Har, is my support. ||2||8||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam sadaa sad jaap ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਸਦੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham suaamee vasadee keenee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Showering His Kind Mercy, the Supreme Lord God Himself has blessed the town. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke se phir tin hee samhaale binase sog sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: The One who owns me, has again taken care of me; my sorrow and suffering is past.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhe jan apane har hoe maaee baap ||1||
lines.translation: He gave me His hand, and saved me, His humble servant; the Lord is my mother and father. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਦਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t hoe miharavaanaa dayaa dhaaree har naath ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures have become kind to me; my Lord and Master blessed me with His Kind Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pare dukh bha(n)jan jaa kaa bad parataap ||2||9||14||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Destroyer of pain; His glory is so great! ||2||9||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: svaamee saran pario darabaare ||
lines.translation: O Lord and Master, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot aparaadh kha(n)dan ke daate tujh bin kaun udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Destroyer of millions of sins, O Great Giver, other than You, who else can save me? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat bahu parakaare sarab arath beechaare ||
lines.translation: Searching, searching in so many ways, I have contemplated all the objects of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g param gat paaeeai maaiaa rach ba(n)dh haare ||1||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the supreme state is attained. But those who are engrossed in the bondage of Maya, lose the game of life. ||1||
